gaps: Regional or area presidents: none exist publicly. The West / Central / East segments are reporting groupings; the Sept 2026 fact sheet and the company divisions page show 16 division presidents (17 divisions, Washington and Utah share one) directly under the Executive Leadership Team. No post-merger regional layer under Sumitomo Forestry has been announced.

Reporting lines: not published. Division presidents are tagged as reporting to President & COO Tom Mitchell (Inferred); division land, operations and marketing VPs are tagged as reporting to their division president (Inferred: the appointment releases say the division president oversees land acquisition).

Division land heads not found for 13 of 17 divisions: Bay Area, Inland Empire-San Diego, Orange County-Los Angeles, Arizona, Las Vegas, Austin, Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, Colorado, DC Metro, Charlotte, Raleigh, Orlando. Company releases quote division presidents, not land VPs; the swarm's shared WebSearch allowance ran out after three searches, so local press and planning records could not be searched. Several division presidents carry land themselves (bios of Frankel, Pasternak, Davenport, Ricks, Francis and Norton name land acquisition as their remit).
Washington and Sacramento: land people found only as HBA/BIA board members with titles from an unverified directory (Yarington, Guerrieri); no division VP of Land Acquisition named.

Coastal Carolinas leadership turnover: Ali Heavener was named founding division president in April 2024 (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/TPH/tri-pointe-homes-expands-its-premium-lifestyle-builder-footprint-7jp2bxmi529j.html); Gray Shell was quoted as division president in May 2025 (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/TPH/tri-pointe-homes-announces-two-land-transactions-in-its-new-coastal-h55no4z88swx.html); Robert Norton replaced him in August 2025. Neither predecessor is recorded as a current person.

Former Orange County-Los Angeles president Tom Grable retired in April 2025 (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/TPH/tri-pointe-homes-announces-retirement-of-division-president-tom-ymlymorf44jl.html); not recorded as current.

Stale land leads not recorded: George Young (VP land acquisition, Carolinas, older Builder article), Jeff Logan (VP land acquisition, 2010 release), Mark Sherman (national VP land development and construction, 2021), Linda Purdy (former Colorado VP land acquisition, later division president, since replaced by Kelly Taga). None confirmed as current.
Open job postings: the company iCIMS board (careers-tripointehomes.icims.com) showed no land acquisition or land development openings on 2026-11-19, so postings could not be used to map the land org.

Altis (55+ brand) has no separate president; it is run inside the divisions (Raleigh runs Altis at Serenity). Legacy brands (Pardee, Trendmaker, Winchester, Maracay, Quadrant, Tri Pointe) were unified as Tri Pointe Homes in 2020, so no brand presidents remain.

Texas Comptroller franchise-tax records for every Tri Pointe Texas entity list only corporate officers (Bauer, Mitchell, Keeler, Lee) and pre-merger directors; no Texas division officers are filed there.
